headings.usage_rules: Use for all large headings (H1, H2), manifesto numbers, and the editorial marquee. Apply 'tracking-tight' for sizes above 32px. Use italic variants for emphasis in the manifesto.

body.usage_rules: Use for all data tables, metric cards, paragraphs, and functional UI elements. Provides a crisp, objective 'Swiss' contrast to the elegant serif headings.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing + High-Density Grid for Data.
rules: No centered layouts for text-heavy sections. Left-align for editorial feel.
Containers with borders must have p-6 or p-8 internal padding.
Hero section MUST use a kinetic staggered line-by-line reveal using Framer Motion.

motion_and_interactions.scrolling: Use @studio-freight/react-lenis for smooth momentum scrolling. This is MANDATORY for the premium feel.
motion_and_interactions.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line text reveal. Apply 'overflow-hidden' on wrappers, and animate 'translate-y-full' to 'translate-y-0' on children.
motion_and_interactions.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee. Slow speed (20-30). Font: Cormorant Garamond italic. Huge text (text-6xl or text-7xl) with low opacity or stroke-only for background texture.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Cards should subtly lift (-translate-y-1) and increase border opacity. Buttons must have explicit hover text colors.

hero.description: Full height (min-h-screen). Deep navy background with subtle gold 3D abstract texture. Huge typographic focus.
hero.elements: Name (Nishant Jain), tagline (Independent Equity Investor & Researcher), 'Scroll to explore' indicator.

dashboard_cards.style: Solid #0A1E3F background (no glassmorphism for data clarity). 1px border border-white/10. Sharp or max rounded-lg.
dashboard_cards.data_colors: Use specific metric colors. Recharts for charts, with dark-mode specific axis colors (stroke='#94A3B8') and custom tooltips with #0A1E3F backgrounds.

manifesto_section.style: Numbered chapters (Idea Generation -> Exit Discipline). Massive serif numerals in #F5A623 or white/10. Staggered fade-in on scroll.

contact_form.style: Use Shadcn Form/Input logic, but styled for marketing. Customize inputs to have transparent backgrounds with border-b border-white/20 (flushed look) or solid dark #0F2A5C blocks.

images.description: Abstract wavy gold/navy pattern. Use with low opacity (10-20%) or blend-mode behind the hero text.
Professional portrait for the 'About/Services' section. Use a spotlight or clipped frame effect.
Abstract golden light streaks. Use for manifesto backgrounds or form section.

testing.rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='contact-submit-button'`, `data-testid='metric-xirr'`).

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: The codebase uses .js/.jsx files. DO NOT use TypeScript (.tsx/.ts). Write all components in standard React JavaScript.
Do not use transparent backgrounds for the sticky header. Use glassmorphism: `bg-[#050E1D]/80 backdrop-blur-md`.
Dashboard charts must use Recharts. Make sure to define a CustomTooltip to match the dark theme.
Do not center align paragraphs. Always left-align for a professional editorial feel.
Ensure color contrast is WCAG AA compliant. Gold on Navy is great, but watch out for dark text on dark backgrounds.
Do not use generic robot/emoji icons. Use lucide-react with thin stroke widths (strokeWidth={1.5}).
universal_guidelines: Follow the 'Old Money Tech' aesthetic. Precision and elegance. Eliminate all unnecessary gradients. Let the typography and data speak. Add micro-interactions (e.g., hover states on data rows). Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
